model.name: test:R30.46 W2 working-file save round-trip (real disk persistence)
model.description: Bridged to test/visual/r3046-working-file-gate.mjs (DET-3x, commit 45ed51ba8). The REAL edit CENTER->Save->fs-read round-trip: saving with left=working (ref=empty) WRITES the on-disk working file and the change PERSISTS to disk (pollution-safe fs restore). DISTINCT 2nd Test on the shared save Impl a88b2b53 alongside 4e2c8f10 - because 4e2c8f10 (r3035 gate) is NON-writing (409-probe/route-intercept, no real disk write) so it does NOT cover real persistence; this is the actual disk-persistence lock for R30.46 W2. Covers AC-w2-save-roundtrip.
